onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to your local vault
onboarding.welcome.desc: Accounts, passwords and two-factor codes stay encrypted on this computer — nothing is uploaded to a server. Thirty seconds now, and day to day the side panel is all you need; the tour opens it once along the way.
onboarding.add.title: Add your first entry
onboarding.add.desc: Enter the site, account and password, then save. Next time you open that site the extension matches it by domain: click the key icon beside the login field to fill it in, or turn on "Auto-submit login" in preferences.
onboarding.add.tip: No password worth keeping? The Generate button in the dialog builds one from your length and character rules.
onboarding.sidepanel.title: Get it back out of the side panel
onboarding.sidepanel.desc: Hit the button below and the panel docks beside this tab: browse what you just saved, search it, star what you use daily. The options page has no site address of its own, so it lists the whole vault — open it on a website's login page and it narrows down to that site's accounts.
onboarding.sidepanel.shortcutHint: Couldn't open it? Press {shortcut} to toggle the side panel.
onboarding.empty.title: Three ways in — pick one
onboarding.empty.desc: Add entries by hand, bulk-import a CSV file, or restore an encrypted .aph backup. The import preview works out how many entries still fit and which ones get skipped.
onboarding.search.title: What you'll lean on later
onboarding.search.desc: Search understands pinyin initials, and tags plus 'favorites only' stack as filters. Select rows to retag, delete or export in bulk.
onboarding.data.title: Backups and migrations live here
onboarding.data.desc: Import/export, encrypted backup, trash and the identity vault share this one menu. An exported .aph only opens with your master password.
onboarding.data.tip: Run an encrypted backup export now — the menu header records your last successful backup.
onboarding.settings.title: Tune the security policy
onboarding.settings.desc: Idle auto-lock, session validity, auto-save, site rules, clipboard clearing and shortcuts all start from this group.
onboarding.health.title: Check your vault regularly
onboarding.health.desc: Finds reused, weak, commonly breached (a near-1,000-entry offline dictionary) and long-unchanged passwords, with a 0–100 score and a per-entry to-do list.
onboarding.personalize.title: Make it look the way you like
onboarding.personalize.desc: Six accent themes, the Chinese/English interface and the floating button's visibility all switch here. Its position isn't a setting — drag the button to the screen edge you want and it snaps into place.
